findings.title: The new verdict check reads quarantined *.rejected.json files, so a stale one blocks every later audit bank
locations: src/CLI/Rounds.jl:347,352,355 (classify_lane quarantines into the same findings/ directory)
findings.before: audit_bank went straight to the claims and then `Rounds.bank`, which reads only `$(lane["nn"])-$(lane["key"]).json` per expected lane; a quarantined `NN-key.rejected.json` was never read again
findings.after: `for f in sort!(filter(endswith(".json"), readdir(fdir)))` — `03-invariants.rejected.json` ends in `.json`, is read, and `return 2`; hint: `re-run it: gbg round rerun $round --lanes ` * replace(f, r"^\d+-" => "", r"\.json$" => "")
findings.why_it_matters: Say an audit lane writes a file that classify_lane quarantines (invalid schema, wrong lane field) and whose verdict also contradicts its findings. The session reruns that lane as the bank told it to, and the new file is clean. At base the re-bank went through. At head, every re-bank returns 2 on the stale quarantined file. The hint names the lane key `invariants.rejected`, which `rerun` refuses as 'not DEAD or REJECTED at the last bank', so the round cannot bank until someone deletes the quarantined file by hand.
findings.description: The check is meant to judge lane files, but it globs every .json in findings/, including the quarantine copies Rounds.classify_lane leaves in that same directory. RAN: a findings dir holding a valid `01-a.json` (CLEAN, []) and `03-invariants.rejected.json` (CLEAN, 1 finding) gives `[("03-invariants.rejected.json", "CLEAN", 1)]`, and the derived rerun key is `invariants.rejected`.
findings.evidence: Output of G.lane_verdict_contradictions: `with stale quarantined file: [("03-invariants.rejected.json", "CLEAN", 1)]`; `rerun key derived: invariants.rejected`. classify_lane: `mv(p, replace(p, ".json" => ".rejected.json"); force = true)`.

findings.title: A lane file with "findings": null now crashes audit_bank (MethodError, exit 3); base quarantined it as DEAD with exit 2
locations: src/CLI/Audit.jl:43-45 (called before the claims and before Rounds.bank)
findings.before: audit_bank ran the claims and then `Rounds.bank`, where classify_lane's schema validation quarantines a `findings: null` file: `return (:dead, nothing, sha, "invalid (quarantined): " * first(errs))`, then 'DEAD/REJECTED lane(s) — ... gbg round rerun'
findings.after: `d = try JSON3.read(...) catch; continue end; v = get(d, "verdict", nothing); v isa AbstractString || continue; n = length(get(d, "findings", Any[]))` — `length(nothing)` throws, and nothing catches it inside audit_bank
findings.why_it_matters: An agent that returns `"verdict":"CLEAN","findings":null` is exactly the malformed lane the generic bank exists to classify. At base that produced exit 2 and a rerun hint. At head, `gbg audit-changes bank` dies with a MethodError backtrace, which Main's catch maps to exit 3 ('crash'). That exit code means a tool defect, not a lane to rerun. A string `findings` has the opposite problem: `length("abc")` counts characters, so a CONCERNS lane with a string findings value passes the check silently.
findings.description: The code comment says 'a file that does not parse, or carries no verdict, is the generic bank's to judge', but a parsed file with a string verdict and a non-array `findings` isn't handed on to the generic bank. RAN: `G.lane_verdict_contradictions` over a dir holding `{"verdict":"CLEAN","findings":null,"lane":"a"}` gives `null findings THROWS: MethodError`, and over `{"verdict":"CONCERNS","findings":"abc"}` it returns `[]` (no contradiction reported).
findings.evidence: Run output: `null findings THROWS: MethodError`; `string findings: Tuple{String, String, Int64}[]`. Main.jl:146-149 `catch err ... return 3`.

findings.title: audit-changes bank now refuses (exit 2) a CLEAN lane that reports findings, which the generic bank accepted before
locations: test/rounds.jl:140-163 (the new test that certifies the refusal)
findings.before: no verdict/findings consistency check; a lane `{"verdict":"CLEAN","findings":[...nits...]}` classified :live and its findings were banked
findings.why_it_matters: The lane schema's own verdict text reads 'CLEAN only if you found nothing in your lens worth the owner reading'. So a lane that files nit-level notes and still calls itself CLEAN met the schema at base and got banked. At head the whole bank refuses and asks for a rerun of that lane, which costs a full agent run and can throw away real findings the lane already reported. The refusal is deliberate and is tested in both directions. Still, it rejects input the instrument used to accept, and neither the lane schema nor the lane briefs were changed to make the rule explicit to the agents producing the files.
findings.description: Behaviour change on the audit instrument's bank path: a verdict/findings disagreement used to be banked on the findings, and is now a hard refusal. The new test (test/rounds.jl) asserts the new behaviour, so it certifies the change rather than checking it against the earlier contract.
findings.evidence: test/rounds.jl: `write(joinpath(fd, "03-invariants.json"), JSON3.write(lane("CLEAN", 1)))` ... `@test G.audit_bank(cfg, id; io = out) == 2`.

findings.title: init now re-renders a freshly seeded test/Project.toml: it strips the seed's comment and, on the tool-itself branch, adds the tool entry its own comment forbids
locations: src/CLI/Init.jl:290-291 (the comment: 'its test environment lists neither a tool entry nor a pin')
findings.before: with no test/ directory at init time, `envs` lacked "test"; the seeded file was written verbatim from `Sync.render(Sync.template("test-Project.toml.seed"), s)` (or the bare `[deps]\nTest = ...` text for the tool itself)
findings.after: `"test" in envs || push!(envs, "test")` — the loop `for e in envs; text, changed = Sync.render_project(cfg, e); changed && write(...)` rewrites it
findings.why_it_matters: RAN (simulated the new pass): with pin 0.3.0, render_project reports changed=true even though deps, sources and compat are unchanged. The re-render drops the seed's comment ('# the package itself, so an `executable_claims` file runs on its own under `--project=test` ...'), which a greenfield consumer (CP) used to receive. On the PKG_NAME branch it turns `[deps]\nTest = ...` into a file with `GBGCodingTools = "3aee1de0-..."` and `[sources] GBGCodingTools = {path = "..."}`, the exact entry the code comment two lines up says the tool's own test env must not list. The dev-pin fix itself is correct: the path source now lands.
findings.description: The fix targets a dev pin, but it runs for every pin and on the tool-itself branch as well, so it is wider than the defect it fixes.
findings.evidence: Simulation output: `=== pin=0.3.0  changed=true  seed-comment-kept=false`; `=== tool-itself (dev pin) changed=true` followed by `GBGCodingTools = "3aee1de0-bb62-4679-b1c5-a861fbcaaa51"` under [deps] and `GBGCodingTools = {path = ...}` under [sources].

findings.title: makedocs' public return value changes from nothing to true on a completed build (the measurement claim holds)
findings.before: `return result` — base docstring: 'Returns whatever `Documenter.makedocs` returns, or `nothing` when an open round of a docs instrument froze the build'
findings.after: `return something(result, true)` — 'Returns what `Documenter.makedocs` returns, `true` when that is `nothing` — as it is unless `debug = true` is passed'
findings.why_it_matters: RAN: Documenter 1.19.0 (docs/Manifest) makedocs.jl:286 is `return debug ? document : nothing`, so the claim is true. At base, a completed build and a frozen skip both returned `nothing`, and the tool's own docs/make.jl `result === nothing || deploydocs(...)` never deployed after a real build. At head it deploys. The fix is real and warranted, but it changes the wrapper's public return contract. Any consumer make.jl written to the base docstring, whether it branches on `result === nothing` or treats the value as a Documenter.Document, now behaves differently on every successful build.
findings.description: The fix is warranted, but it changes a public contract, and the change should be recorded as such, not only as a comment in the extension.
findings.evidence: /home/grigory/.julia/packages/Documenter/13nbQ/src/makedocs.jl:274 `function makedocs(; debug = false, ...)`, :286 `return debug ? document : nothing`; pkgversion 1.19.0.
